title: Supplier document intake, procurement reconciliation, and governed handoff
customer_role: Manufacturing procurement operator and quality-document reviewer
business_problem: Process supplier invoices and certificates, match them to purchasing and part records, route ambiguity, write approved facts exactly once, and deliver an auditable workbook.
models: OCR and document extraction selected by the generated workflow
workflow_result: A generated workflow performs intake, extraction, validation, reconciliation, review routing, exactly-once writeback, and workbook delivery.
independent_oracle: Three hidden seeds each verify 36 records, workbook cells and formulas, host final state, permissions, fault recovery, duplicate suppression, and write receipts.
revision_semantics: Revisions 1 through 15 are iterations of this project only.
current_blocker: Revision 15 is a preserved customer failure: after 10 model calls and 624,339 tokens, the daemon durably created one pending workspace_write for work/cbc.json, but the runner had relayed only through tool.requested event 472 while permission.requested was event 478. It observed waiting_permission and queried the Studio projection before synchronizing the later events, then incorrectly terminated with no automatic permission decision. Host requests, artifacts, receipts, reports, archive validation, and oracle runs all remained zero.
next_action: Preserve revision 15, verify a generic post-wait relay synchronization barrier, and freeze a child revision only if the task, permissions, budget, hosts, oracle, CAP gate, and acceptance remain unchanged.
